name: io.github.cyanheads/seerr-mcp-server
description: Search Jellyseerr/Overseerr, check availability, and create guarded media requests.

environmentVariables.name: SEERR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Jellyseerr/Overseerr instance, e.g. http://host:5055. No /api/v1 suffix, no trailing slash.

environmentVariables.name: SEERR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Seerr API key (Settings → General → API Key), sent as the X-Api-Key header.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
